messages:
Maya Lin (Sales): Quick handoff for Aurelia Labs — closed today. Primary asks: EU data residency, Okta SSO + SCIM, predictable monthly commit (look for 250k tokens/day avg), and a 99.9% uptime SLA.
Maya Lin (Sales): Trial summary: multi-team PoC, ~80k tokens/day now with 2x spikes on weekdays; 11k embeddings/day. Pilot runs for 8 weeks; they want cost certainty after week 6.
Maya Lin (Sales): Renewal flag: procurement has a hard budgeting window in 45 days. If we can't provide a capped cost option / reserved tier, they may shift to a competitor.
Maya Lin (Sales): Attached: contract draft + network diagrams -> https://drive.redwood/aurelia/contract (internal). CC: @Priya Kaur @Dexter Ng @Sam Park
Priya Kaur (CS): Taking ownership of onboarding. I'll send kickoff invite Tuesday. Need: technical lead contact, Okta metadata, expected concurrency, and sample prompt/embedding datasets.
Priya Kaur (CS): Also want to capture their eval criteria up-front (latency SLOs, token cost target, quality thresholds). Planning a short enablement for their ML infra team.
Dexter Ng (Customer Eng): For EU residency we can spin a VPC in eu-west-1. Need to validate embedding throughput under 13B quant models. Please share ~2000 embedding examples and 100 short prompt traces.
Dexter Ng (Customer Eng): Also: do they require the private control plane or is VPC-only ok? That impacts timeline (private plane = +2 weeks for entitlements).
Sam Park (Support): I'll draft the escalation matrix and incident runbook. Ask: who is on their side for after-hours? We need a 24/7 contact if SLA enforced.
Maya Lin (Sales): POC: Anika Bose (anika@aurelia.ai), mobile +44-7700-111222. After-hours: Tomasz Zielinski (tomasz@aurelia.ai). Billing: finance@aurelia.ai.
Priya Kaur (CS): Proposed owners + due dates: 1) Kickoff + agenda (Priya) — Tue EOD; 2) SSO/SCIM test (Priya + CS Enablement) — Day 3 after kickoff; 3) VPC provisioning (Dexter) — Day 7; 4) Perf sweep + tail latency report (Dexter) — Day 9; 5) Incident playbook (Sam) — Day 5; 6) Pricing tiers + reserved proposal (Priya + Sales) — Day 4.
Priya Kaur (CS): I'll also collect sample prompts to build a small eval set (owners: Priya & Aurelia ML lead). Will add to shared drive.
Dexter Ng (Customer Eng): For perf sweep I'll run with open-llama-13b-quant and a 4-bit variant and post results. If they want sub-200ms p95 on <64-token prompts, that may need dedicated capacity.
Dexter Ng (Customer Eng): Example curl for webhook they asked for (for errors/usage alerts):
Dexter Ng (Customer Eng): ```bash
Dexter Ng (Customer Eng): curl -X POST https://aurelia.example/webhook -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"alert":"usage_threshold","value":90000}'
Dexter Ng (Customer Eng): ```
Sam Park (Support): I'll pre-load SOC2 Type II, ISO docs, and a DPIA checklist into the drive and flag any gaps. Also suggest initial 2-week 24/7 on-call ramp, then move to business-hours + escalations.
Priya Kaur (CS): Risk level: elevated (procurement timeline + cost sensitivity). Mitigation: 1) deliver pricing tiers + cap options within 4 days; 2) run targeted pilot for cost/perf; 3) weekly exec updates.
Priya Kaur (CS): Feedback capture plan: we'll instrument prompt/response sampling, capture quality labels from their SMEs weekly, and surface regressions to engineering via a weekly eval digest. Owner: Priya + Aurelia ML lead.
Maya Lin (Sales): They're also asking for a usage alert threshold + integration to their PagerDuty. I'll coordinate with their SRE to confirm event format.
Dexter Ng (Customer Eng): Noted. I'll sketch an events schema and share in the thread.
handoff-bot: Handoff ticket created -> https://internal.redwood/handoffs/1765812345 assigned to Priya Kaur (CS).
Priya Kaur (CS): I'll run the first status update on Friday and post the kickoff notes here. Reopening thread once kickoff complete. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
